solo.definition:
n. any activity that is performed alone without assistance
n. a musical composition for one voice or instrument (with or without accompaniment)
n. a flight in which the aircraft pilot is unaccompanied
v. fly alone, without a co-pilot or passengers
solo.translation:
n. 独奏, 独唱, 单独表演
a. 单独的, 独奏的, 独唱的
vi. 放单飞

solo climbing.translation: 单人徒手攀岩（或登山）；单人攀登

solo homer.translation: 一分本垒打（垒上无跑垒员时击出的本垒打）

solo man.translation:
na. 梭罗人
[网络] 索伦人；索罗人；爪哇

solodyne.translation: 只用一个电池组工作的接收机(线路)

soloist.definition: n. a musician who performs a solo
soloist.translation: n. 独奏者, 独唱者

soloistic.translation: a. 独唱的, 独奏的

soloists.translation: n. 独唱者, 独奏者, 单飞者( soloist的复数形式 )

solomon.definition: n. (Old Testament) son of David and king of Israel noted for his wisdom (10th century BC)
solomon.translation:
n. 所罗门(古以色列国王), 聪明人, 贤人
[计] 所罗门阵列处理机

solomon islander.translation: 所罗门群岛 (Solomon Islands的变形)

solomonic.definition: a. exhibiting or requiring the wisdom of Solomon in making difficult decisions
solomonic.translation: a. 所罗门王的；大智大慧的, 智的

solomons.definition: n. the northernmost islands are part of Papua New Guinea; the remainder form an independent state within the British Commonwealth
solomons.translation:
所罗门斯
所罗门人

solon.definition: n a man who is a respected leader in national or international affairs

solovieff's phenomenon.translation: [医] 索洛维耶夫氏现象(手足搐搦时左侧膈肌的节律性痉挛)

solovki.translation: abbr. Solovetski Islands 索罗维特斯基岛（流放刑事犯的地区，在前苏联的阿尔汉格尔斯克地区，是古拉格群岛的一部分）
